ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 60 percent high-intensity white pixels to 40 percent low-intensity black pixels, creating high global contrast between central regions and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white contiguous zones are centered on the medial-lateral areas of both lobes. These zones are bounded by low-intensity black perimeters at the hinge and leading edges. Significant dark pixel clustering (mottling) and circular geometric blobs are distributed irregularly across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped angle of approximately 52 degrees with a high-depth bounding box relative to the height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 to 20 pixels, isolated clearly from the bright water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a strong convex sweep, tapering into prominent, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of localized, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) with dark perimeters and light centers scattered throughout the white fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial-white field of the left lobe and distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (likely barnacle or lamprey marks) globally distributed; presence of a distinct vertical linear artifact near the right distal tip extending toward the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and symmetrical density of 'ring-style' scars creates a high-frequency texture across the ventral surface not typical of average pigmentation.
